text:
alex: perf-bot alerted: CI perf-gate failed on PR #21459 — microbench/kernel_matrix delta +6.8% (threshold 3%). https://ci.internal.redwood/21459
perf-bot: [alert] benchmark: kernel_matrix | suite: microbench | delta +6.8% | golden: 0.123ms -> 0.132ms
chen: ugh, saw same in local runs. Repro with `bazel test //perf:kernel_matrix --runs_per_test=10` - gave +6% consistently
sam: any obvious suspect? recent commits touched kernel selector + batcher heuristics
alex: bisect points at commit c3f9d2a — changed kernel_cost_estimator behavior, altered scoring to prefer throughput kernels for medium seqlen
marta: attaching quick flamegraph snapshot (trimmed):
```
flamegraph
select_kernel_for_layout
  kernel_cost_estimator
    choose_kernel
      kernel_matrix_compute (60% hot)
```
chen: also noticed KV cache hit rate drop ~2% on a shadow run. If hit rate falls, batching patterns change (smaller batches), could amplify kernel delta
sam: can you run microbench with KV toggled? command I use:
```
PERF_DEBUG=1 KV_CACHE_ENABLED=0 ./tools/microbench --bench kernel_matrix --repeat 50
```
alex: ran that — with KV disabled the delta reduces to +1.2%, so KV interaction looks relevant
marta: marking this merge as rollout-blocker. Need either a revert or a hotfix within the hour so downstream SLAs don't regress
chen: quick options: 1) revert c3f9d2a (safe, fast) 2) tweak estimator to bias low-latency kernels for seqlen<128 (less safe without tests)
sam: I vote revert + follow-up PR to rework estimator and add new microbench golden for this pattern
ci-bot: created revert PR #21500 and queued it for CI: https://ci.internal.redwood/21500
alex: added bisect notes to PR and a perf ticket to add a golden test covering medium-seqlen + KV-hit variation
marta: :thumbsup: prioritize the revert. After revert and green CI, we can iterate on a robust fix
perf-bot: [note] full perf traces uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/traces/4423456789/trace.tar.gz
sam: ack. i'll monitor the revert CI. If it passes, we'll roll forward and then plan a controlled reintroduce with more coverage
alex: copying the microbench command and flamegraph paste into the PR for context. Will follow up with a short postmortem if root cause deviates after deeper profiling
marta: thanks all — keep updates here, please
